```{r}
library(WDI)
library(tidyverse)

wdi_gini <- WDI(
  country = c("US", "CA", "GB", "FR", "BR"),
  indicator = c("SI.POV.GINI", "SP.DYN.IMRT.IN"),
  start = 2022,
  end = 2022
)

dim(wdi_gini)
```

```{r}
wdi_gini <- WDI(
  country = "all",
  indicator = c("SI.POV.GINI", "SP.DYN.IMRT.IN"),
  start = 2022,
  end = 2022
)

dim(wdi_gini)
```

```{r}
clean_gini <- wdi_gini %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SI.POV.GINI),
    !is.na(SP.DYN.IMRT.IN)
  )

dim(clean_gini)
```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)

graph_gini <- clean_gini %>%
  rename(
    Gini = SI.POV.GINI,
    Infant_Mortality = SP.DYN.IMRT.IN
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Continent = countrycode(iso3c, "iso3c", "continent")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Continent))

dim(graph_gini)
```

```{r}
ui_gini <- fluidPage(

  titlePanel("Income Inequality vs. Infant Mortality (2022)"),

  sliderInput(
    "gini_range",
    "Select Gini Coefficient Range:",
    min = floor(min(graph_gini$Gini)),
    max = ceiling(max(graph_gini$Gini)),
    value = c(
      floor(min(graph_gini$Gini)),
      ceiling(max(graph_gini$Gini))
    )
  ),

  sliderInput(
    "y_max",
    "Select Maximum Infant Mortality Rate:",
    min = 10,
    max = ceiling(max(graph_gini$Infant_Mortality)) + 5,
    value = ceiling(max(graph_gini$Infant_Mortality)) + 5,
    step = 1
  ),

  plotlyOutput("gini_scatterplot")
)
```

```{r}
server_gini <- function(input, output) {

  output$gini_scatterplot <- renderPlotly({

    filtered_data <- graph_gini %>%
      filter(
        Gini >= input$gini_range[1],
        Gini <= input$gini_range[2]
      )

    p <- ggplot(
      filtered_data,
      aes(
        x = Gini,
        y = Infant_Mortality,
        color = Continent,
        text = paste0(
          "Country: ", country,
          "<br>Continent: ", Continent,
          "<br>Gini Index: ", round(Gini, 1),
          "<br>Infant Mortality: ",
          round(Infant_Mortality, 1),
          " deaths per 1,000 live births"
        )
      )
    ) +
      geom_point(size = 2.5) +
      geom_smooth(
        aes(group = 1),
        method = "lm",
        se = FALSE,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Gini Coefficient vs. Infant Mortality (2022)",
        x = "Gini Index (0–100)",
        y = "Infant Mortality (per 1,000 live births)",
        color = "Continent"
      )

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
      layout(
        yaxis = list(
          range = c(0, input$y_max),
          autorange = FALSE
        )
      )

  })
}

shinyApp(ui_gini, server_gini)
```
